plugins.name: shipstar
plugins.description: Automated product marketing from your commits: generate changelogs, blog posts, KB articles, release emails, and social posts, then review, publish, and email them — driven by Shipstar's hosted MCP server with guided skills for releases, blogging, mailing lists, and site banners.

skills.name: add-announcement-banner
skills.description: Put a Shipstar announcement banner at the top of the user's website: a one-line bar (headline, one sentence, call-to-action) announcing the most impactful change of the period, generated from their commits, reviewed, published, and auto-updated by a weekly or monthly schedule. Covers generating the first banner over MCP, embedding it with one script tag (or rendering it server-side from the API), and setting up the schedule. Use when the user wants to highlight what shipped at the top of their site, asks for an announcement bar / site banner / "what's new" strip, or wants visitors to notice a feature this week or this month.
headings: 2. Generate and review the first banner
skills.description_zh: 根据提交记录为网站顶部生成 Shipstar 公告横条，包含标题、一句说明和行动入口，突出本期主要变化，经审核后发布并按周或月自动更新。支持 MCP 生成、单个脚本嵌入或 API 服务端渲染及定时配置。

skills.name: announce-release
skills.description: Announce a release with Shipstar: generate a changelog and release-notes email from recent commits, review the drafts with the user, then publish and email subscribers. Use when the user says they shipped, released, or launched something and wants it announced, or asks to "run the release marketing". Requires the Shipstar MCP server to be connected.
skills.description_zh: 通过 Shipstar 从近期提交生成变更日志和版本通知邮件，与用户复核草稿后发布并发送给订阅者。适用于版本发布或上线公告及发布营销，要求连接 Shipstar MCP。

skills.name: build-changelog-page
skills.description: Build a server-rendered, agent-readable changelog page on the user's own website from their Shipstar changelog data: semantic HTML crawlers and answer engines can actually read, per-period permalink pages, an RSS feed, structured data, and the SEO / AEO layer (titles, descriptions, Open Graph, crawler policy, llms.txt, answer-shaped copy) that makes it rank and get cited. Use when the user wants their changelog on their own domain, asks to make their changelog crawlable / SEO-friendly / readable by AI agents, or notes that the embed widget renders nothing for search engines. Requires a Shipstar API token; works in any server-rendering web stack (examples assume Next.js-style ISR).
headings: 6. Optimise for search and answer engines
AEO (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overviews)
skills.description_zh: 依据 Shipstar 变更日志数据，在自有域名构建服务端渲染且可被爬虫和智能体读取的页面，提供分期永久链接、RSS、结构化数据、标题描述、Open Graph、爬虫策略及 llms.txt。要求 API 令牌，可用于各类服务端渲染技术栈；排名和引用效果为原说明所述目标，需实际验证。

skills.name: email-your-users
skills.description: Send a release-notes email to the project's mailing lists via Shipstar: generate the email from recent commits, review it with the user, pick the lists, and send with one-click unsubscribe handling. Use when the user wants to email customers/users about a release or send release notes. Requires the Shipstar MCP server.
headings: Email release notes to your users
skills.description_zh: 通过 Shipstar 为项目邮件列表发送版本通知，从近期提交生成邮件、与用户复核、选择列表并发送，处理一键退订。适用于向客户或用户通知发布，要求 Shipstar MCP。

skills.name: setup-shipstar
skills.description: Connect this agent to Shipstar and verify the project is ready for automated release marketing. Use when the user wants to set up Shipstar, connect the Shipstar MCP server, or when another Shipstar skill fails because the MCP connection or project setup is incomplete.
skills.description_zh: 将智能体连接到 Shipstar，并验证项目是否具备自动发布营销条件。适用于初始设置、MCP 连接或其他技能因连接及项目配置不完整而失败。

skills.name: write-blog-post
skills.description: Write and publish a blog post from recent development work using Shipstar: brainstorm angles from commits, generate a draft, revise it with the user, and publish. Use when the user wants a blog post, dev-blog entry, or article about what they've been building. Requires the Shipstar MCP server.
headings: Write a blog post from shipped work
skills.description_zh: 通过 Shipstar 依据近期开发工作撰写并发布博客，从提交中探索角度、生成草稿、与用户修订后发布。适用于开发博客或构建进展文章，要求 Shipstar MCP。
